import math
colors=['7FB5AD','A5B56F','A3B467','A8B86F','A1B36B','9FAF68','AEBB75','9EB268']
def lab(h):
 rgb=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
 rgb=[((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4 if c>0.04045 else c/12.92 for c in rgb]
 x=rgb[0]*0.4124+rgb[1]*0.3576+rgb[2]*0.1805
 y=rgb[0]*0.2126+rgb[1]*0.7152+rgb[2]*0.0722
 z=rgb[0]*0.0193+rgb[1]*0.1192+rgb[2]*0.9505
 x,y,z=x/0.95047,y,z/1.08883
 f=lambda t:t**(1/3) if t>0.008856 else 7.787*t+16/116
 fx,fy,fz=f(x),f(y),f(z)
 return (116*fy-16,500*(fx-fy),200*(fy-fz))
for c in colors:
 print(c,tuple(round(x,2) for x in lab(c)))
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
import colorsys, math, hashlib, re, json
root=Path('.')
colors={'茉莉':'E3DFC6','乌龙':'6F7D50','白桃':'D98F79','桂花':'C79543','青柠':'A1B36B'}
old='7FB5AD'
def lab(h):
 rgb=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
 rgb_lin=[((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4 if c>0.04045 else c/12.92 for c in rgb]
 x=rgb_lin[0]*0.4124+rgb_lin[1]*0.3576+rgb_lin[2]*0.1805
 y=rgb_lin[0]*0.2126+rgb_lin[1]*0.7152+rgb_lin[2]*0.0722
 z=rgb_lin[0]*0.0193+rgb_lin[1]*0.1192+rgb_lin[2]*0.9505
 x,y,z=x/0.95047,y,z/1.08883
 f=lambda t:t**(1/3) if t>0.008856 else 7.787*t+16/116
 fx,fy,fz=f(x),f(y),f(z)
 return (116*fy-16,500*(fx-fy),200*(fy-fz))
oldlab,newlab=lab(old),lab(colors['青柠'])
print('old_lime_lab',tuple(round(x,2) for x in oldlab))
print('new_lime_lab',tuple(round(x,2) for x in newlab))
print('lightness_delta',round(abs(oldlab[0]-newlab[0]),2))
rgb=[int(colors['青柠'][i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
h,l,s=colorsys.rgb_to_hls(*rgb)
print('new_lime_hsl',round(h*360,1),round(s*100,1),round(l*100,1))
labs={k:lab(v) for k,v in colors.items()}
pairs=[]
for i,a in enumerate(colors):
 for b in list(colors)[i+1:]:
  de=math.sqrt(sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(labs[a],labs[b])))
  pairs.append((round(de,2),a,b))
print('min_pair_deltaE76',min(pairs))
print('oolong_lime_deltaE76',[p for p in pairs if set(p[1:])=={'乌龙','青柠'}][0])

for p in [root/'outputs/v1/01_strategy_b_full_five_sku_series.png',root/'outputs/v1/02_strategy_b_shelf_thumbnail_check.png',root/'outputs/v1/03_strategy_b_generated_shelf_context.png']:
 im=Image.open(p); print(p.name, im.size, im.mode)

# Untouched lid-zone comparison for all five structure-locked main-board packs.
source=Image.open(root/'inputs/02-approved_base_packaging.png').convert('RGB')
src_crop=source.crop((325,130,695,910))
card_w=(2400-180-24*4)/5
card_top=180
pack_h=640
pack_w=pack_h*370/780
expected=src_crop.resize((round(pack_w),pack_h),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
board=Image.open(root/'outputs/v1/01_strategy_b_full_five_sku_series.png').convert('RGB')
maes=[]
for i in range(5):
 x=90+i*(card_w+24)+(card_w-pack_w)/2
 y=card_top+112
 crop=board.crop((round(x),round(y),round(x)+round(pack_w),round(y)+pack_h))
 a=list(expected.crop((0,0,expected.width,115)).getdata())
 b=list(crop.crop((0,0,crop.width,115)).getdata())
 mae=sum(abs(x-y) for pa,pb in zip(a,b) for x,y in zip(pa,pb))/(len(a)*3)
 maes.append(round(mae,3))
print('untouched_lid_zone_mae_rgb',maes)

src=open(root/'outputs/v1/render_strategy_b_series.m').read()
print('flavor_data_entries',len(re.findall(r'@\\{@\"name\": @\"(?:茉莉|乌龙|白桃|桂花|青柠)\"',src)))
print('new_lime_occurrences',src.count('#A1B36B'))
print('old_lime_occurrences',src.count('#7FB5AD'))

for p in sorted((root/'outputs/v0').glob('*')):
 if p.is_file():
  h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
  print('v0_sha256',p.name,h)
PY"
